---
title: Object Interaction
---

Select, touch, grab, move, and release an interactive cube. Its color reports
interaction state: idle yellow, ray-selected blue, and directly touched green.

Use the simulator's Hands mode to test virtual-hand contact, or tracked hands
on a device. A ray selection and direct touch follow different input lifecycles.
See [simulator controls](/sdk/simulator) for moving the active hand and toggling
its pinch state.

[Select and manipulate objects](/sdk/interaction) · [Input events](/sdk/input) · [Example catalog](/examples)
